objects: phased-in permanent with an ordinary printed Prowess fragment

events: one ordinary trigger per current Prowess instance
state_reads: cast-spell controller and canonical card types
timing: the trigger is detected only after the cast transaction completes under CR 601.2i
choices: same-controller simultaneous triggers use the ordinary trigger-order continuation
apnap: all represented triggers from the completed cast share one ordinary placement batch
layers: ability removal in layer 6 suppresses future Prowess triggers

copy: granted or copied Prowess requires separately trusted typed ability-fragment propagation
control_change: the source controller at trigger creation controls the trigger; the result follows the same logical source object
zone_change: a source that leaves and returns is a different object and receives no modifier from the old trigger
source_leaves: the trigger remains on the stack but its source-zone-object result becomes inapplicable

variants: source leaves or changes control after the trigger
known_blockers: Oracle-equivalent nonkeyword trigger wording remains unsupported

aggregate casting, continuous effects, and triggered abilities remain incomplete
